speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing frequent nosebleeds, bleeding from your mucous membranes, and petechiae; to understand the cause, have you noticed any bruising easily or prolonged bleeding from cuts? Also, is your family history notable for similar bleeding issues?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP). The presentation of frequent epistaxis, gum bleeding, petechiae on the distal extremities, and easy bruising in a 4-year-old male is classic for ITP. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with Platelet Count.
